title: Kundalini's Orbit
description: A skeletal queen wearing a crown and regal purple robes sits on a throne inside an ornate blue doorway. She is flanked by four skeletons in various poses, one kneeling with a tray, while glowing green orbs containing candles float above in a circular formation against a psychedelic background of swirling patterns and red lightning.
prompt: A regal skeletal queen with a golden crown and flowing purple robes sits on a throne within an ornate blue doorway labeled 'Kundalini's Orbit'. Four black skeletons attend her, one kneeling with a tray of skulls, another holding a skull. Glowing translucent teal orbs with candles float in a circular pattern around her, set against a dark psychedelic background of swirling patterns, red lightning bolts, and intricate mystical symbols.
